entities.summary: The Munich Coinage Treaty of 1837 was a treaty between six southern German states who agreed to form the South German Coinage Union and to unify their currencies together with some of the central German states. The Munich Coinage Treaty was updated by the South German Coinage Convention of 1845. The agreement is less commonly known as the Munich Coin Treaty.
